_README: Accumulated local ground truth for greeceforamericans. Every entry OVERRIDES facts.json and any AI output, permanently. Stage 3 loads this alongside facts.json before writing any batch. Append whenever the user corrects a fact, recommendation, or recurring style mistake — future articles inherit the fix automatically.

corrections.wrong: Phrasing like 'fly home from Santorini' / 'fly home from the last island', implying direct US flights exist from Cycladic islands.
corrections.right: There are NO direct US flights from the islands. Athens (ATH) is the only US gateway. The final island->Athens leg is a DOMESTIC connection. Always phrase as 'fly back to Athens to connect home' or 'the short flight back to Athens', never 'fly home from <island>'.
corrections.applies_to: all itinerary/island-hopping/segment articles ending on an island
